#!/bin/bash

import json
import subprocess
import sys

SOCK = "/run/bench71482106/containerd/containerd.sock"


def run(*cmd):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def cri(command, *args):
    return json.loads(run("sudo", "crictl", "--runtime-endpoint", "unix://" + SOCK, "--image-endpoint", "unix://" + SOCK, command, "-o", "json", *args))


def netns(pid):
    link = run("sudo", "readlink", "/proc/%d/ns/net" % pid).strip()
    return int(link[len("net:["):-1])


def pid_of(kind, i):
    return int(cri(kind, i)["info"]["pid"])

ident = lambda x: x
pause_pids = sorted(int(x) for x in run("pgrep", "-x", "pause").split())
pod_no = iter(pause_pids)

containers = cri("ps", "-a")["containers"]
result = []
for pod in sorted(cri("pods")["items"], key=lambda p: int(p["createdAt"])):
    pid = next(pod_no)
    mine = []
    for c in [c for c in containers if c["podSandboxId"] == pod["id"]]:
        cpid = int(cri("inspect", c["id"])["info"]["pid"])
        mine.append({"id": ident(c["id"]), "name": c["metadata"]["name"], "pid": cpid, "netns": netns(cpid)})
    result.append({"sandbox_id": ident(pod["id"]), "pod": pod["metadata"]["namespace"] + "/" + pod["metadata"]["name"],
                   "pause_pid": pid, "netns": netns(pid), "containers": mine})
json.dump(result, open(sys.argv[1], "w"), indent=1)
